description: Input Data Heat Demand Model Passive House Planning Package (PHPP) is a data set deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors Chelsea Kaandorp, Tes Miedema. This data has been used to arrive at the results presented in the paper `Reducing committed emissions of heating towards 2050: Analysis of scenarios for the insulation of buildings and the decarbonisation of electricity generation' from Kaandorp et al. (2022). Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. Formats: Excel. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
